name: MAMI (Mainz Microtron)
notes: kind linac is a stand-in: MAMI is a cascade of racetrack and harmonic double-sided microtrons (a recirculating linac), as the CEBAF record does.

summary.plain: MAMI is the electron accelerator of Mainz University: a cascade of racetrack microtrons that produces high-precision electron beams up to 1.5 GeV, used to study the structure of the nucleon and of atomic nuclei.
summary.technical: Mainz Microtron: three racetrack microtrons in sequence (MAMI B, 855.1 MeV, 90 circulations) followed by a harmonic double-sided microtron (MAMI C, 1508 MeV, 43 circulations), continuous-wave electron beam at 2.45 GHz; operated since the 1980s; recorded as a linac because ACCELERATOR_KINDS has no microtron.
